_doc: Territories (regions) and goodwill. Goodwill 0–100 per region toward your railroad; restricted regions need a charter: granted at charterGoodwill or bought for charterFee (× (1 + years since 1830 / 60)). Construction in a region costs × (costAt0 + (costAt100 − costAt0) × goodwill/100). Monthly goodwill: + perServedStation for each of your stations with trains, + revenue/perRevenue (capped), − idleStation for stations without trains, then drift towards 50; one-offs: − perDemolished building, − bulldozedStation, − wreck. See BALANCING.md.
